Subject: DevCon Summit 2026 — initial package and stage slot

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — great to hear Redwood is interested in a larger presence at DevCon Summit (May 2027). I attached the sponsorship package v3 with pricing and the exhibit map. Quick highlights relevant to what we discussed:

- Platinum package (limited to 6): keynote visibility, full-page program ad, and a 45-minute TOC-friendly theater slot (afternoon)
- Exhibit: double island (20x20) adjacent to main stage (booth #A14) — premium foot traffic
- Branding: primary logo on stage backdrop and on main registration banner (2 positions)
- Lead capture: badge-scan counts + access to CSV post-event
- Add-ons: dedicated green room signage, one sponsored breakfast, and partner-led workshop rooms (up to 90 min)

Attachments: DevCon_Sponsorship_Package_v3.pdf, ExhibitMap_Apr2026.pdf

We can hold the platinum slot for you until Oct 28. If you want the 45-minute theater session to be promoted as a keynote-adjacent slot (higher visibility), we can include a stage rider that guarantees placement before the main keynote — that requires a signed rider by Nov 5.

Thoughts on next steps? If the booth placement and primary logo locations are must-haves, tell me and I will flag them in the SOW.

Best,
Samantha

Subject: Re: DevCon Summit 2026 — initial package and stage slot

Hi Samantha — thanks for the package and the quick follow-up. We reviewed internally and have a few asks before we proceed: 

1) Logo placement: primary on stage backdrop is a must. We also need a second prominent logo position on the conference app home screen (not just the registration banner). Can you confirm app placement is possible under Platinum?

2) Stage rider: we want the 45-minute session to be scheduled in the first slot after the opening keynote or immediately before — audience drop-off after lunch tends to be harsh. If you can guarantee pre-keynote or immediately post-opening, we can accept the rider.

3) Exhibit positioning: booth #A14 is acceptable but we prefer to be nearer the demo corridor entrance (higher product-demo traffic). Any flexibility to shift to A12 or the corner adjacent to the demo corridor?

4) Lead data & privacy: we need the lead CSV to include opt-in flags and the full badge metadata for our internal GDPR review; please confirm shipping timeline for the CSV (prefer within 48 hours of show close).

We will also want a short clause in the SOW that the event will not book competing LLM inference platform vendors within the same keynote slot (category exclusivity) — if you can propose language, happy to review.

Cc'ing Marissa (field marketing) and Connor (BD) to keep them in the loop. If you can send a revised SOW with those items called out, we will try to get legal review on our side quickly.

Thanks,
Hannah
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

Team — forwarding DevCon's package and my list of asks. Quick thoughts and recommended priorities: 

- Marissa: prioritize app home-screen placement and green-room signage. Those are high-visibility for product marketing and should be in our must-have column. Also confirm whether we want breakfast sponsorship one day or both days (I prefer day 1).
- Connor: negotiate exhibit corner (A12) and ask for two additional lead scans per booth (no extra fee). Also push for category exclusivity around inference providers during the main stage sessions.
- Laura: legal redline to include a clause: lead CSV must include consent/opt-in flag and delivered within 48 hours post-event. Also propose a cancellation/fallback clause if keynote scheduling moves our slot to off-peak.

If everyone agrees, we ask Samantha for a redlined SOW and the stage rider text. I think we can accept the overall spend with those protections.

Hannah
